title: Sorry I’m late!
goal: Explain an interruption and apologise for a delay
freeConversationInstruction: Talk about unexpected moments and ask what the other person was doing when something happened

pages.title: Review the last lesson
pages.instruction: Tell a short sequence from last weekend

items.prompt: What did you do last weekend?

pages.title: Name the pictures
pages.instruction: Say each word or expression in English, then click a picture to check and listen

items.example: I was waiting for the bus
items.audioText: wait for the bus. I was waiting for the bus.

items.example: I missed the bus when I went into the shop
items.audioText: miss the bus. I missed the bus when I went into the shop.
drop a phone. She dropped her phone outside.

items.example: He got stuck in traffic near the station
items.audioText: get stuck in traffic. He got stuck in traffic near the station.
start raining. It started raining at twelve.
arrive late. I arrived late for lunch.

pages.title: Listen and read
pages.instruction: Rain at the bus stop. Listen for the problem, the response and the next step

lines.speaker: Kim
lines.text: You’re here! Are you all right?
lines.audioText: You’re here! Are you all right?

lines.speaker: Ana
lines.text: Yes, sorry I’m late. I was waiting for the bus when it started raining
lines.audioText: Yes, sorry I’m late. I was waiting for the bus when it started raining.
lines.translation: Sim, desculpe o atraso. Eu estava esperando o ônibus quando começou a chover

lines.speaker: Kim
lines.text: Oh no! Did you have an umbrella?
lines.audioText: Oh no! Did you have an umbrella?
lines.translation: Ah, não! Você estava com guarda-chuva?

lines.speaker: Ana
lines.text: No. I went into a shop, and then I missed the bus
lines.audioText: No. I went into a shop, and then I missed the bus.
lines.translation: Não. Entrei em uma loja e depois perdi o ônibus

questions.prompt: What was Ana doing when it started raining?
questions.answer: Ana was waiting for the bus
No, Ana didn’t have an umbrella

questions.prompt: Why did Ana miss the bus?
questions.answer: Ana missed the bus after going into a shop to get out of the rain

pages.title: Listen and read
pages.instruction: Finally at the café. Listen for the problem, the response and the next step

lines.speaker: Kim
lines.text: What did you do after that?
lines.audioText: What did you do after that?

lines.speaker: Ana
lines.text: I took the next bus, but it was very slow
lines.audioText: I took the next bus, but it was very slow.
lines.translation: Peguei o ônibus seguinte, mas ele estava muito lento

lines.speaker: Kim
lines.text: Don’t worry. We can still have lunch
lines.audioText: Don’t worry. We can still have lunch.
lines.translation: Não se preocupe. Ainda podemos almoçar

lines.speaker: Ana
lines.text: Thanks for waiting. Next time I’ll leave earlier!
lines.audioText: Thanks for waiting. Next time I’ll leave earlier!
lines.translation: Obrigada por esperar. Da próxima vez vou sair mais cedo!

questions.prompt: How did Ana travel after missing the bus?
What was the next bus like?
questions.answer: The next bus was very slow

questions.prompt: What will Ana do differently next time?
questions.answer: Ana will leave earlier next time

pages.title: Put the pictures in order

pages.title: Tell the story
pages.instruction: Explain the delay. Use the three time anchors to explain what happened

pages.title: Listen and answer
pages.instruction: Leo is delayed too. Listen for the new information and decide how to respond
pages.message: Hi, Ana. Leo just called me. He was driving to the café when he got stuck in traffic. There’s a lot of traffic near the station, so he’s running late too. He thinks he can be here at one thirty. He’s fine, and he says we should order our food now. Shall we get a table?
pages.audioText: Hi, Ana. Leo just called me. He was driving to the café when he got stuck in traffic. There’s a lot of traffic near the station, so he’s running late too. He thinks he can be here at one thirty. He’s fine, and he says we should order our food now. Shall we get a table?
pages.greeting: I’ve heard from Leo about the traffic

items.answer: Leo got stuck in traffic near the station

items.prompt: What time does Leo expect to arrive?
items.answer: Leo expects to arrive at one thirty

items.prompt: What does Leo suggest they do while waiting?
items.answer: Leo suggests that they order their food now

pages.title: Respond to the message
pages.instruction: Update the lunch plan. Use the message to update your response and agree on the next step

pages.title: Watch and answer
pages.instruction: Watch two travel problems, then explain a delay politely

items.prompt: How long is the first delay?
items.answer: The flight is delayed by at least two hours

items.prompt: Why is the flight in the next example cancelled?
items.answer: It’s cancelled because of bad weather

items.prompt: How does the traveller avoid blaming the employee?
items.hint: Listen to the reply after the apology
items.answer: The traveller says it isn’t the employee’s fault

items.prompt: You arrived late because your train stopped. What can you say?
items.answer: Example: Sorry I’m late. My train stopped and I had to wait
